# snort

Set up the Snort IDS, its configuration and dependencies

This module copies the config and sets up the dependencies (Snort and its DAQ).
It does not include the launch line, one could run something like:
```bash
sudo LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/tom/dpdk-shared/x86_64-native-linuxapp-gcc/lib/:/home/tom/dpdk-shared/x86_64-native-linuxapp-gcc/:/usr/local/lib/ snort --daq dpdkring --daq-mode inline --daq-var dpdk_args="-l 0-7 --proc-type secondary" --daq-var "dpdk_pool=click_mempool_ring_16917" -i dpdk0:dpdk1 -c snort.conf
```

Source: [`modules/snort.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/snort.npf)

## Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NPFROOT` | `../` | Path to the NPF root, where libs/snort holds the Snort archives |
